RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Rapid capacitor
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: Repeated hits against the last discharge target charge 35 instead of 25. Target-switch charging and the original 2-second discharge cooldown remain.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Arc relay
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: After Fulmination actually injures its discharge target, arc once to the nearest other standing hostile within 3 cells among at most 3 local candidates. Deal 30% of resolved discharge damage, up to 75. This arc cannot charge or discharge Fulmination.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Insulated recoil
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: After Fulmination actually injures its discharge target, grant the wearer a 20-point shield for 3 seconds if their current barrier is below 20. Preserves stronger-shield replacement rules.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Purifying rhythm
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: Each abnormal state actually cleared by Quicksilver reduces this activation's cooldown by 1.5 seconds, up to 6 seconds; final cooldown is at least 6 seconds. Healing is part of the item's base cleanse and is not repeated by this card.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Freedom ward
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: A successful Quicksilver cleanse grants a 30-point shield for 3 seconds if the wearer's current barrier is below 30. No shield is created by a no-op activation.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Released counter
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: A successful Quicksilver cleanse arms one 18-point additional hit for 5 seconds. The next positive direct hostile hit consumes it before callbacks. Removing the item, dying or leaving the map cancels it; additional damage cannot trigger another counter.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Sacrificial resolve
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: Share 20% instead of 14%, retaining the 75-point payment cap and 30% protector health floor.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Worthy return
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: The pledged ally's resolved hostile damage repairs 18% instead of 12%; final injury repair remains capped at 20 per event.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Afterguard
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: After a transfer with actual paid cost and the ally's hit has resolved, grant the ally a 25-point shield for 3 seconds if their existing barrier is weaker. At most once every 8 seconds.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Extended stillness
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: Stasis lasts 3 seconds instead of 2.5. Item haste still affects only cooldown.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Golden emergence
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: Only natural stasis expiry grants a 20-point shield for 3 seconds if the existing barrier is weaker. Cancellation grants no shield.

RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.label: Recovered time
RimHex.HexEquipmentCardDef037.description: Only natural stasis expiry repairs 20% of the damage blocked during this stasis, up to 25 injury points. Blocked-damage accounting is capped at 200. No blocked damage or early cancellation gives no repair.
